ambient: The wind hums across the horn.
Lead creaks as it cools.

157.name: The Narrow Watch
157.text: A narrow watch post looks down the road through a slit in the wall. A cot, a stool and a cold brazier fill the room. A slate ledger hangs from a nail beside the slit, its last page empty.

details.slit: The slit frames the road and the dark treeline. Nothing moves on it.
details.cot: The cot is unmade. The blanket is thin and damp.
details.ledger: The ledger's last page is blank except for a date and a single word: 'Quiet.'

ambient: The brazier ticks as it cools.
Wind worries at the slit.

158.name: The High Hall
158.text: A second hall occupies the upper floor, smaller and colder than the great hall below. A long table is set with cracked plates, and a high seat stands against the wall beneath a torn banner. The back stair descends to the servants' wing, the library is west, and a study lies south.

details.table: The table is set for a meal that was never eaten. The plates are cracked and dry.
details.high seat: The high seat is carved with a red hand. The cushion has been slashed.
details.banner: The banner is torn. A name has been cut from the cloth.

ambient: A plate rocks on the table.
The banner stirs in a draft.

159.name: The Study
159.text: The study is small and cluttered, with a desk under the window, a chest against the wall and books stacked on every surface. A map of the keep is pinned to the desk, marked with a red circle beneath the chapel. The balcony is west; the high hall is north.

details.desk: The desk is covered with notes. One page repeats a single word: 'Sealed.'
details.chest: A small chest with a brass lock. The key is missing.
details.map: The keep map marks a sealed room beneath the ossuary. The circle is fresh.

ambient: A page slides from the desk.
The window glass ticks in its frame.

160.name: The Sealed Room
160.text: The sealed room is a narrow cell of dry stone, hidden behind the ossuary wall. A single coin rests on a stone shelf, and a tall shape stands in the corner with its back to the door. The air is cold and still, and the coin catches the light like an eye.

details.coin: A pale coin, older than the keep. A closed hand is stamped on its face.
details.shape: The shape is tall and still. It has not turned, but it knows you are here.
details.shelf: The shelf is dry and clean. The coin is the only thing on it.

ambient: The coin rings faintly.
The shape breathes once, very slowly.
160.darkText: The sealed room is black. A single point of pale light rests on a shelf, and something tall stands in the corner.

161.name: The Tower Cell
161.text: A small cell is cut into the tower wall, its only light a slit above head height. Chains hang from an iron ring, and a thin prisoner sits against the wall with a scrap of blanket. A narrow door west returns to the tower stair.

details.chains: The chains are old and short. The manacles are open.
details.prisoner: The prisoner is thin and very still. His eyes follow you.
details.slit: The slit shows a slice of grey sky and the edge of the roof.

ambient: A chain shifts against the wall.
The prisoner breathes out slowly.
161.darkText: The tower cell is dark. Chains shift somewhere close, and a thin slit of grey light hangs above.

162.name: The Spiral Stair
162.text: A narrow stair winds up through the Arcanum, its walls set with lamps that burn without smoke. The steps are worn in the centre, and the air grows colder with every turn. A landing opens above; the guild hall falls away below.

details.lamps: The lamps are cold glass globes. A pale light moves inside them without heat.
details.steps: The steps are worn into shallow cups. A chalk mark counts the turns.
details.walls: The walls are set with small stones that catch the light like eyes.

ambient: The lamps dim and brighten in a slow rhythm.
A draft climbs the stair, smelling of cold metal.

163.name: The Hall of Names
163.text: Plaques of black stone line the hall, each cut with the name of a mage and a date. A brass orrery turns at the centre of the floor, and doors open north and south. The air is very still, as if the room is listening.

details.plaques: The names are old. The newest plaque is blank except for a cut line.
details.orrery: The orrery turns without a mechanism. The planets are small and very cold.
details.floor: The floor is a mosaic of a sky. One star is missing.

ambient: A plaque ticks as it warms.
The orrery completes a turn and begins again.

164.name: The Lecture Hall
164.text: Tiered benches face a chalk board covered in half-erased diagrams. A lectern stands at the centre, and the air smells of chalk and cold stone. Doors lead up to the laboratories, east to the observatory and west to the star stair.

details.board: The diagrams show a circle within a circle. The last line is smudged.
details.benches: The benches are empty. One has a chalk mark in the shape of a hand.
details.lectern: The lectern is plain wood. A dry quill lies across it.

ambient: Chalk dust falls from the board.
A bench creaks under no weight.

165.name: The Scriptorium
165.text: Slanted desks fill the scriptorium, each with a candle stub and a dry inkpot. Scrolls hang from racks along the wall, and a narrow door east leads to the prism chamber. The room smells of paper, wax and old ink.

details.desks: The desks are scored with careful lines. One holds a half-finished scroll.
details.racks: The racks are full of scrolls. Most are copies of the same warning.
details.ink: The inkpots are dry. One still holds a skin of black ink.

ambient: A scroll edge curls in a draft.
The candle stubs gutter together.

166.name: The Lower Laboratory
166.text: Benches of glass and copper fill the lower laboratory, and a cold furnace squats against the wall. Jars of reagents line the shelves, and a door east leads to the rune gallery. The air is sharp and faintly bitter.

details.furnace: The furnace is cold. A thin residue of silver clings to its mouth.
details.jars: The jars are labelled in a careful hand. One is cracked and empty.
details.benches: The benches are stained with rings. A pair of tongs lies in the dust.

ambient: A jar ticks as it cools.
The bitter smell catches the back of the throat.

167.name: The Upper Laboratory
167.text: The upper laboratory is a round room of copper coils and glass vessels. A furnace glows faintly at the centre, and a stone golem stands beside it with its hands in the coals. Doors lead down to the lecture hall, up to the sealed vault and east to the bellows.

details.furnace: The furnace is banked but alive. The coals are white at the heart.
details.coils: The copper coils hum. A thin blue spark crawls along one.
details.golem: The golem is jointed stone. Its hands are buried in the coals.

ambient: The coils hum a note too low to hear.
A coal shifts in the furnace.

168.name: The Observatory
168.text: A great brass telescope fills the observatory, pointed at a slit in the roof. Star charts cover the walls, and a desk holds a lamp and a half-finished calculation. A stair climbs to the aviary; the lecture hall is west.

details.telescope: The telescope is tall and cold. The lens is clear and very deep.
details.charts: The charts show a star that is not in the sky. It is circled in red.
details.desk: The desk is covered in calculations. The last line is unfinished.

ambient: The telescope ticks as it tracks.
A star chart lifts at the corner.

169.name: The Star Stair
169.text: The star stair climbs through a shaft of black stone, its steps lit only by narrow openings in the wall. The air is cold and thin, and the stair turns so tightly that the wall is always at your shoulder. The mirror room waits above.

details.slits: The slits show slices of night sky. The stars do not move.
details.steps: The steps are narrow and worn. A fine frost covers the edges.
details.wall: The wall is cold and smooth. A chalk star is drawn at eye height.

ambient: A draft climbs the shaft.
Frost crackles underfoot.
169.darkText: The star stair is dark. Cold air climbs past you, and the steps are edged with frost. A thin slit of sky shows somewhere above.

170.name: The Prism Chamber
170.text: A prism of pale glass stands on a stone plinth at the centre of the chamber, turning slowly in a light that has no source. The walls are faceted, and the floor is a mosaic of a white star. A door north leads to the archivist's study; the scriptorium is west.

details.prism: The prism is cold and clear. A white light turns inside it.
details.plinth: The plinth is plain stone. The prism has worn a shallow cup in the top.
details.mosaic: The star has eight points. One point is missing.

ambient: The prism turns a fraction and stops.
A white reflection crosses the wall.

171.name: The Rune Gallery
171.text: Runes cover the gallery walls in tight, interlocking lines. A low stone table holds a bowl of black sand, and the north wall is smooth except for a single carved eye. The runes are cold to the touch and very sharp.

details.runes: The runes are cut deep. They shift when seen from the corner of the eye.
details.table: The table is stained black. The sand in the bowl is warm.
details.eye: The carved eye is closed. A thin line of dust runs from its corner.

ambient: The runes click softly.
The black sand stirs without wind.

172.name: The Sealed Vault
172.text: The sealed vault is a windowless room of black stone. A stone chest sits at the centre, its lid bound with silver wire, and the walls are covered in older seals. The air is dry and still, and the only door returns down to the laboratory.

details.chest: The chest is stone, bound with silver wire. The wire is unbroken.
details.seals: The seals are older than the guild. One has been scratched away.
details.walls: The walls are black and warm. A faint light moves behind them.

ambient: The silver wire hums.
A seal cracks somewhere in the wall.

173.name: The Bellows
173.text: A great leather bellows fills the room, its mouth joined to a copper pipe that climbs through the ceiling. A stone golem works the handle in slow, patient strokes, and the air is hot and dry. The upper laboratory is west; the orrery waits above.

details.bellows: The bellows are cracked but whole. The leather is dark with soot.
details.pipe: The pipe is hot. A thin whistle escapes at a joint.
details.golem: The golem's hands are worn smooth. It does not look up.

ambient: The bellows sighs and fills.
The pipe ticks as it heats.

174.name: The Aviary
174.text: The aviary is open to the sky through a broken dome. Owls nest in the rafters, their eyes catching the light, and the floor is white with droppings and old feathers. A stair descends to the observatory; the mirror room is west.

details.owls: The owls are pale and silent. One turns its head without moving its body.
details.dome: The dome is cracked. A night sky shows through the gap.
details.feathers: The feathers are white and grey. One is longer than a hand.

ambient: An owl shifts on the beam.
A feather turns slowly to the floor.

175.name: The Mirror Room
175.text: A tall mirror of black glass fills the far wall, its surface rippling like water. The room is bare except for a stone bench and a mark on the floor where something has been dragged. A stair descends to the star stair; the aviary is east, and the star well waits above.

details.mirror: The mirror reflects the room, but the reflection is a half-step late.
details.bench: The bench is cold. A handprint is burned into the stone.
details.mark: The mark is dark and old. It runs from the mirror to the stair.

ambient: The mirror ripples.
A reflection moves at the edge of sight.

176.name: The Archivist's Study
176.text: The study is crowded with shelves, boxes and a desk buried under paper. A narrow stair climbs to the prism vault, and the prism chamber is south. The archivist's chair is turned away from the door, and a cold cup sits beside the lamp.

details.desk: The desk is covered with letters. One is sealed with a red hand.
details.shelves: The shelves hold boxes of index cards, each tied with black thread.
details.chair: The chair is turned to the wall. It is warm.

ambient: A page turns on the desk.
The cold cup rings softly against the wood.

177.name: The Cold Library
177.text: The cold library is a narrow room of frosted shelves. Books stand in blocks of ice, their titles blurred, and the air is so cold that breath hangs. The rune gallery is south; the high walk east.

details.shelves: The books are frozen shut. One cover is clear enough to read: 'On the Sealed Eye'.
details.ice: The ice is clear and blue. A dark shape is frozen at the centre of one block.
details.air: The air is sharp and still. Frost grows on every edge.

ambient: Ice creaks in the shelves.
A frozen page turns with a sound like a knife.
177.darkText: The cold library is dark. Frost creaks around you, and the air is sharp enough to cut.

178.name: The High Walk
178.text: The high walk runs around the tower's crown, open to the sky on one side and walled on the other. Gargoyles crouch at the corners, their stone wings spread, and the valley lies far below. The sealed vault is south, the cold library west and the orrery east.

details.gargoyles: The gargoyles are weathered but whole. One has a fresh chip at the jaw.
details.valley: The valley is grey and green. The keep is a small dark shape at the road.
details.wall: The wall is carved with a long list of names. The last is unfinished.

ambient: Wind pulls at the walk.
A gargoyle's wing creaks.

179.name: The Orrery
179.text: A great orrery fills the room, its brass rings turning around a cold white sun. The floor is a map of the sky, and the air smells of oil and old metal. The bellows are below, the high walk west and the star well north.

details.orrery: The orrery is enormous. Its planets are small and very cold.
details.sun: The white sun is glass. A crack runs through it.
details.floor: The floor is a sky map. One star is missing.

ambient: The orrery turns with a soft click.
A brass ring hums.

180.name: The Star Well
180.text: The star well is a round shaft open to the night sky, its walls set with cold lamps. A narrow walk circles the well, and the water at the bottom reflects stars that are not overhead. The mirror room is below, the orrery south, and a warded gap opens east.

details.well: The well is deep. The water reflects a sky that is not the one above.
details.lamps: The lamps are cold. Their light falls upward.
details.walk: The walk is narrow and wet. The stone is furred with frost.

ambient: A star moves in the water.
The lamps dim together.
180.darkText: The star well is black. Cold lamps glow somewhere above, and the water below reflects a sky that is not there.

181.name: The Prism Vault
181.text: The prism vault is a high room of black glass and silver wire. A white prism hangs at the centre, turning slowly, and shelves of sealed boxes line the walls. A stair descends to the archivist's study; the star well is west.

details.prism: The prism is white and perfect. Its light falls on every surface at once.
details.boxes: The boxes are sealed with silver wire. One has been opened and left empty.
details.walls: The walls are black glass. Your reflection is very small.

ambient: The prism turns and the light shifts.
A silver wire hums.
181.darkText: The prism vault is dark except for a white point of light turning at the centre. Silver wires hum in the black glass.

task.note: The Vault carries the word; the Shrine asks for it.

claim.prompt: what is carved on the Vault door

npcs.name: a rat
npcs.examine: A thin rat with wet fur and a torn ear.

npcs.name: a moth
npcs.examine: A pale moth, large as a hand.

npcs.name: a bard
phrases: The bard hums something older than the walls.
The bard says: every word here is borrowed.
npcs.examine: The bard's fingers never stop moving. He watches the door more than the strings.
dialogue: The Vault keeps the word, but the Shrine keeps the answer.
I have sung in courts that no longer have names.
The stone guard in the Vault is older than the temple.

npcs.name: a guard
npcs.examine: The guard is carved from pale stone. The sword at its side is not.
dialogue: The Shrine is safe. The Vault is not.
I am stone. I do not sleep.
The Chancel notices are for those with clearance.

npcs.name: a shopkeeper
npcs.examine: The shopkeeper has the patient face of someone who has heard every offer.
dialogue: Lamp oil, torches, and a fair price.
The smith sells blades; I sell light.
A crate in the back says the Vault lies. I did not write it.

npcs.name: a vault guardian
npcs.description: A stone figure stands where the Vault's shadow falls.
npcs.examine: The guardian's eyes are chips of black stone. Its hands are closing.

npcs.name: the smith
npcs.description: The smith is broad and soot-stained, and watches the door.
npcs.examine: A heavy apron, scarred hands, and a hammer within reach.
dialogue: Steel is honest. People are not.
The jerkin is cheap because it has been mended.
The guardian in the Vault was made to be still.

npcs.name: the innkeeper
npcs.description: The innkeeper wipes a cup and watches the room.
npcs.examine: She has a quick eye for a full purse and an empty one.
dialogue: Stew is three coins. Bread is cheaper.
The east room has a window. The west room has a chest.
Travellers say the graveyard is restless.

npcs.name: a market woman
npcs.description: A market woman stands behind a shuttered stall.
npcs.examine: Her stall smells of rope and dried herbs.
dialogue: Rope, herbs, and gossip. The gossip is free.
The boar at the forest edge has ruined two stalls.
The guild clerk is at the hall, through the inn.

npcs.name: the guild clerk
npcs.description: A clerk keeps a ledger by the door.
npcs.examine: The ledger has a column for every guild, and most are empty.
dialogue: A guild needs a name and a leader. The rest is bookkeeping.
The hall is neutral ground. No blood.
The crypt has been feeding on the town's dead.

npcs.name: a wild boar
npcs.description: A boar roots at the edge of the trees.
npcs.examine: Its tusks are long and yellow. It has not seen you yet.

npcs.name: a grey wolf
npcs.description: A grey wolf watches from between the trees.
npcs.examine: It is thin, and its eyes are steady.

npcs.name: a ghoul
npcs.description: A ghoul crouches among the broken tombs.
npcs.examine: Its skin is drawn tight over the bones, and its mouth is wet.

npcs.name: a sewer rat
npcs.description: A rat the size of a cat watches from the waterline.
npcs.examine: Its fur is slick and its teeth are yellow.

npcs.name: a smuggler
npcs.description: A lean man in a tarred coat stands behind the chest.
npcs.examine: He has a knife at his belt and mud to the knee.
dialogue: You did not see this room.
The river has a hundred mouths, and I know most of them.
The guild clerk asks too many questions.

npcs.name: a dockhand
npcs.description: A dockhand coils rope at the end of the pier.
npcs.examine: His hands are cracked and tarred.
dialogue: The lighthouse has been dark for a week.
The keeper does not answer the door.
The fog comes in with the tide.

npcs.name: the lighthouse keeper
npcs.description: The keeper stands in the cottage door, watching the sea.
npcs.examine: He is old and salt-burnt, and his eyes never leave the water.
dialogue: The lamp is cold. The oil is gone.
Something came in with the last tide and did not leave.
The telescope is yours if you can use it.

npcs.name: the ring keeper
npcs.description: The ring keeper leans on the rail with a ledger under one arm.
npcs.examine: She has a fighter's broken nose and a bookmaker's patience.
dialogue: A duel is agreed before it is fought. duel <name>, then let them accept.
No blades outside the Ring. Inside, no one takes your goods.
The board remembers the winners. It does not remember the reasons.

npcs.name: the archmage
npcs.description: The archmage stands beside the orrery, sleeves stained with ink and ash.
npcs.examine: A tall figure with a brass ring on one finger and a patient, predatory gaze.
dialogue: The Mages' Guild takes those who can read what is not written. Join, and the first spell is yours.
Spark, mend, light, shield, detect, recall. Each has a price and a rank.
The orrery is a clock. It is also a warning.

npcs.name: the spellwright
npcs.description: A thin woman with ink-stained cuffs and a careful smile.
npcs.examine: Her hands are steady; her eyes are not.
dialogue: Scrolls are cheaper than lessons. Lessons are cheaper than mistakes.
The archmage sends me the students who break things.
A note went missing from the stair. I would like it back.

npcs.name: an apprentice
npcs.description: A young apprentice carries a stack of chalk and a look of permanent worry.
npcs.examine: Chalk dust on the sleeves, a charm tucked into the collar.
dialogue: The yard is safe. The fountain is not.
I lost my charm by the fountain.
The owl knows more than it says.

npcs.name: an owl
npcs.description: A pale owl, large as a cat, watches from the highest beam.
npcs.examine: Its eyes are two small moons.
phrases: The owl turns its head without moving its body.
The owl says: the high walk sees what the arcade hides.
The owl says: bring a light, not a blade.
dialogue: The high walk sees what the arcade hides.
A candle on the rail is worth more than a crown.
The mirror below remembers every face.

npcs.name: a mirror-wraith
npcs.description: A tall shape in the pool, made of reflected light and old anger.
npcs.examine: It has your face, and it is not your face.
dialogue: You should not have looked.
The pool keeps what it is given.

npcs.name: the warden
npcs.description: A hulking shape of wet stone and iron, with a key at its belt.
npcs.examine: The warden was made to keep a door. It has forgotten which.
dialogue: The door does not open.
The key is mine.

npcs.name: a drowned clerk
npcs.description: A clerk in a tarred coat, standing knee-deep in the drowned library.
npcs.examine: His ledger is full of blank pages.
dialogue: The library is closed.
Every name is a door.

npcs.name: a thin cat
npcs.description: A thin grey cat, dry in a flooded vault.
npcs.examine: The cat is warm. It should not be.
dialogue: The cat does not answer.
The cat watches the water.

npcs.name: the choir moth
npcs.description: A great black moth, wings wide as a door.
npcs.examine: Its wings are marked with closed eyes.
dialogue: The choir does not sing.
The lantern is the last one.

npcs.name: the reliquary keeper
npcs.description: A tall figure in white, face hidden behind a lens.
npcs.examine: The lens shows a room that is not this one.
dialogue: The chest is not for you.
The lens sees the quiet door.

npcs.name: the last keeper
npcs.description: An old keeper sits beneath the last lantern.
npcs.examine: The keeper is warm. The lantern is not.
dialogue: The quiet door has no handle.
The lantern is the last one.
Take it, and the door will know you.

npcs.name: the forge master
npcs.description: A broad figure in a leather apron waits beside the cold forge.
npcs.examine: The forge master's hands are scarred and steady.
dialogue: The door remembered you.
The first flame is deeper than the coals.
The hound in the garden has a fang worth taking.

npcs.name: a cinder hound
npcs.description: A lean hound the colour of cooling slag.
npcs.examine: Its hide is cracked like a dried riverbed, and heat shows through the cracks.

npcs.name: the ember warden
npcs.description: A tall figure of black iron stands at the edge of the flame.
npcs.examine: The warden is jointed like a furnace door, and its eyes are coals.

npcs.name: a fen wisp
npcs.description: A cold light drifts above the reeds.
npcs.examine: The wisp is a small flame with no fuel and no heat.

npcs.name: a bog hound
npcs.description: A lean hound the colour of wet peat.
npcs.examine: Its fur is matted with mud and its eyes are yellow.

npcs.name: the heron keeper
npcs.description: A tall figure in a cloak of grey feathers stands beside the root.
npcs.examine: The keeper's hands are stained green.
dialogue: The fen remembers every footstep.
The green key opens the vault.
The heart is older than the mill.

npcs.name: a brine crab
npcs.description: A crab the size of a dog, shell crusted with salt.
npcs.examine: Its claws are stained green.

npcs.name: the tide hermit
npcs.description: A figure in oilskin sits on the drowned altar.
npcs.examine: The hermit's hands are webbed with old scars.
dialogue: The tide keeps what it takes.
The brine key opens the vault.
The salt heart is older than the lighthouse.

npcs.name: a salt wraith
npcs.description: A tall shape of white salt and cold air.
npcs.examine: The wraith has no face, only a seam of black.

npcs.name: a moon hare
npcs.description: A white hare with eyes like glass.
npcs.examine: Its fur is silver at the tips.

npcs.name: the silver owl
npcs.description: A silver owl sits on a low branch.
npcs.examine: The owl's eyes are two small moons.
dialogue: The moonwell keeps what is reflected.
The bone key opens the chest.
The stag guards the throne.

npcs.name: the moon stag
npcs.description: A tall stag with antlers of clear glass.
npcs.examine: Its antlers hold a light that is not there.

npcs.name: the eclipse herald
npcs.description: A herald in a cloak of white ash waits at the top of the stair.
npcs.examine: The herald's face is hidden, but the cloak is very old.
dialogue: The stair opens only after the stag falls.
The knight keeps the key. The regent keeps the sigil.
The dawn gate is the way back. It was always the way back.

npcs.name: a star hound
npcs.description: A lean hound with a coat of fixed stars.
npcs.examine: Its eyes are two points of white, and its teeth are very long.

npcs.name: the sundial knight
npcs.description: A knight in armour the colour of a closed eye.
npcs.examine: The knight's visor is a slit of darkness. It does not move until you do.

npcs.name: the eclipse regent
npcs.description: A tall figure in a crown of burnt glass sits on the throne of ash.
npcs.examine: The regent's hand is closed around a sigil. The crown ticks as it cools.

npcs.name: the rememberer
npcs.description: An old figure sits on the bench with a closed book.
npcs.examine: The rememberer's hands are stained with ink and soil.
dialogue: The garden keeps what the shrine forgets.
Bring me a word you learned and I will plant it.
A word is only remembered when someone else can hear it.

npcs.name: a garden wisp
npcs.description: A small light drifts above the white rose.
npcs.examine: The wisp is warm and does not speak.

npcs.name: the root keeper
npcs.description: A small figure sits at a desk grown from roots.
npcs.examine: The keeper's hands are stained with black soil.
dialogue: Every bed remembers who planted it.
The first seed is not for eating.
The archive keeps the names the garden cannot.

npcs.name: the orchard keeper
npcs.description: A small figure stands beside the old press.
npcs.examine: The keeper's hands are stained with black soil.
dialogue: The orchard remembers the word ORCHARD.
The windfall keeps one seed for the press.
The town remembers what the roots carry.

npcs.name: a vat hound
npcs.description: A wet black hound circles the vat.
npcs.examine: Its coat smells of cider and iron.

npcs.name: the spring keeper
npcs.description: A quiet figure sits above the white bed.
npcs.examine: The keeper's hands are clean and cold.
dialogue: The spring remembers the word SPRING.
The white bed keeps one bloom for the cups.
The orchard drinks from here.

npcs.name: the warden-captain
npcs.description: The warden-captain is weathered and quiet, with a map case under one arm.
npcs.examine: Mud to the knee, a broken compass at the belt, and a stare that keeps counting exits.
dialogue: The Wardens do not sit in halls. We walk the edges and come back with the map.
Scout, ranger, warden. Rank is measured in ground covered, not in speeches.
The fen eats the careless. The salt caves eat the proud. The moonlit reach eats both.

npcs.name: the night broker
npcs.description: The night broker keeps to the shadows behind the smuggler's table.
npcs.examine: A narrow figure in a dark coat, with a ledger no honest merchant would keep.
dialogue: The Night Market takes what the daylight will not.
A runner carries. A cutpurse keeps. A shadow decides. A master owns the dark.
Bring me a blade and I will tell you whose hand it was made for.

npcs.name: the ashen priest
npcs.description: A grey figure stands beside the reliquary, face hidden under a hood of ash-cloth.
npcs.examine: The priest's sleeves are stained with soot and old wax. A cracked symbol hangs at the throat.
dialogue: The Hand does not promise light. It promises an answer.
The choir sings because it has forgotten how to stop.
Drain the false flame. Keep what it took.

npcs.name: the red captain
npcs.description: A broad figure in red-stained leathers waits at the fen gate, axe across her knees.
npcs.examine: Scarred knuckles, a chipped axe, and a grin that expects a fight.
dialogue: The Red Company takes the field, not the hall.
Rage is a tool. Use it before it uses you.
The eclipse court is full of things worth killing. Bring me proof.

npcs.name: the training master
npcs.description: The training master sits on a stool with a stick across worn knees.
npcs.examine: A weathered fighter with a wooden leg and a very direct stare.
dialogue: Take a practice blade, wield it, and attack the dummy. It will not hit back.
A weapon technique is a stance, not a spell. technique lists what your kit can do.
When the dummy is easy, try the Ring beneath the Docks. That one hits back.

npcs.name: a training dummy
npcs.description: A straw dummy on a wooden post, patched and re-patched.
npcs.examine: Straw, sacking and a great deal of practice.

npcs.name: a red gate guard
npcs.description: A broad guard in a red cloak stands beside the portcullis, spear grounded.
npcs.examine: The guard's spear is notched. A red hand is stitched over the breast of the cloak.

npcs.name: a red bailey guard
npcs.description: A guard in a mud-spattered red cloak watches the fountain.
npcs.examine: The guard's boots are wrapped with cloth against the cold. A knife hangs at the belt.

npcs.name: a red hall guard
npcs.description: A tall guard stands at the high table with a naked blade across his arms.
npcs.examine: The blade is plain and sharp. The guard's eyes never leave the doors.

npcs.name: a brindled hound
npcs.description: A brindled hound lifts its head from the straw. Its eyes are yellow and steady.
npcs.examine: The hound is thin, but its shoulders are heavy. A red collar is half-buried in its fur.

npcs.name: a red barracks guard
npcs.description: A guard sits on the nearest bunk, cleaning her nails with a knife.
npcs.examine: The knife is thin and well used. A red cloak is folded beside her.

npcs.name: the grey steward
npcs.description: A thin man in a grey coat stands at the high table, hands folded.
npcs.examine: The steward's coat is old but carefully mended. His hands are ink-stained.
dialogue: The Grey Keep was a border house before the Red Company came. Now it is a waystation for things that do not want to be seen.
The captain keeps the tower. The vault key is in the solar chest, or it was when the last steward had it.
The chapel is the only safe room left. The curator does not ask where your treasures came from.

npcs.name: the keep cook
npcs.description: A round woman in a stained apron stirs the cold stew with a wooden spoon.
npcs.examine: The cook's hands are scarred with old burns. A knife hangs at her waist, but she does not reach for it.
dialogue: Take the bread and the stew. The cellar is dark, and the dark is not kind.
The guards eat first. The rest of us eat what the guards leave.

npcs.name: the ash curator
npcs.description: A figure in ash-grey robes stands beside the reliquary, face hidden in a deep hood.
npcs.examine: The curator's sleeves are clean. A pale scar crosses the back of one hand.
dialogue: The reliquary takes worth and returns what the living can carry. Offer a treasure, and it will give you experience.
Gold is for the living. A thing of worth is for the road. Choose what you can leave behind.
The chapel is safe. The rest of the keep is not.

npcs.name: the red captain
npcs.description: A tall figure in a red cloak stands at the parapet, blade drawn.
npcs.examine: The captain's blade is old and very clean. A signet ring glints on the sword hand.

npcs.name: the prisoner
npcs.description: A thin prisoner sits in the far cell with a bowl of water beside him.
npcs.examine: His wrists are scarred, but the chains no longer hold him. His eyes are clear.
dialogue: The vault key is in the solar chest. The captain wears the only other key, and he does not lend it.
The vault is dark. Take a light, or the dark will take you.
I have been here longer than the captain. I know the sound of that door.

npcs.name: a black vault hound
npcs.description: A black hound stands beside the plinth, eyes catching the thin seam of light.
npcs.examine: The hound's coat is rough and hot. Its collar is iron, and the tag is worn smooth.

npcs.name: a red gallery guard
npcs.description: A guard in a red cloak stands at the turn of the gallery.
npcs.examine: The guard's boots are quiet on the carpet. A short blade hangs at her side.

npcs.name: the grey librarian
npcs.description: A thin figure in a grey coat sorts books at the far shelf.
npcs.examine: The librarian's hands are ink-stained and careful. A brass key hangs at the belt.
dialogue: The cabinet holds the star chart. The map room knows more than the library.
The sealed room is beneath the ossuary. The wall is cracked wider than it looks.

npcs.name: a thin servant
npcs.description: A thin servant stands by the hearth with a wooden spoon.
npcs.examine: The servant's sleeves are rolled. Her hands are red from the cold.
dialogue: The cook keeps the stew for the guards. Take a bowl if you must.

objects.examine: A brass orrery turning around a cold white sun. The sun has a crack.

objects.name: the black mirror
objects.examine: A tall mirror of black glass. Your reflection is a half-step late.

objects.name: a mirror shard
objects.examine: A shard of black glass. Your reflection is missing.

objects.name: a study chest
objects.examine: A small chest of dark wood, bound with silver. The lock is open.

objects.name: a sealed codex
objects.examine: A codex bound in black leather. The clasp is a closed eye.

objects.name: a frozen book
objects.examine: A book frozen in a block of clear ice. The title is 'On the Sealed Eye'.

objects.name: the prism heart
objects.examine: A white prism the size of a fist. Its light falls on every surface at once.

objects.name: a flask of star water
objects.examine: A flask of cold water with a fixed star at the bottom.

weather.text: A fog clings to the walls.
A cold wind finds the corridors.
